import scipy.stats as stats
import numpy as np

# VLA-only baseline (updated seed45: 9% -> 11%)
vla_seeds = {'42': 0.12, '43': 0.12, '44': 0.10, '45': 0.11, '46': 0.13}
vla_counts = {k: int(v * 100) for k, v in vla_seeds.items()}

vla_means = np.array(list(vla_seeds.values()))
vla_mean = np.mean(vla_means)
vla_std = np.std(vla_means, ddof=1)

# obs_only epsilon=0.2 (K=10, 6 seeds)
obs_seeds = {'42': 0.22, '43': 0.16, '44': 0.16, '45': 0.16, '46': 0.15, '47': 0.20}
obs_counts = {k: int(v * 100) for k, v in obs_seeds.items()}
obs_total_success = sum(obs_counts.values())
obs_total_n = 600
obs_means = np.array(list(obs_seeds.values()))
obs_mean = np.mean(obs_means)
obs_std = np.std(obs_means, ddof=1)

print('=== Raw Data ===')
print(f'VLA-only: seeds={vla_counts}, pooled={vla_total_success}/{vla_total_n} ({vla_total_success/vla_total_n:.4f})')
print(f'  mean={vla_mean:.4f}, std={vla_std:.4f}, n_seeds={len(vla_seeds)}')
print(f'obs_only: seeds={obs_counts}, pooled={obs_total_success}/{obs_total_n} ({obs_total_success/obs_total_n:.4f})')
print(f'  mean={obs_mean:.4f}, std={obs_std:.4f}, n_seeds={len(obs_seeds)}')

# 1. Fisher exact test (two-sided)
# Contingency table:
#              success  failure
# obs_only     105      495
# vla_only     58       442
table = np.array([[obs_total_success, obs_total_n - obs_total_success],
                  [vla_total_success, vla_total_n - vla_total_success]])
print(f'\n=== Fisher Exact Test (two-sided) ===')
print(f'Contingency table:')
print(f'  obs_only: {obs_total_success} success, {obs_total_n - obs_total_success} failure (n={obs_total_n})')
print(f'  vla_only: {vla_total_success} success, {vla_total_n - vla_total_success} failure (n={vla_total_n})')
odds_ratio, p_value = stats.fisher_exact(table, alternative='two-sided')
print(f'  Odds ratio: {odds_ratio:.4f}')
print(f'  p-value (two-sided): {p_value:.6f}')

# Also one-sided for reference
_, p_greater = stats.fisher_exact(table, alternative='greater')
print(f'  p-value (one-sided, obs > vla): {p_greater:.6f}')

# 2. Cohen's d (per-seed means) - unpooled
# d = (mean1 - mean2) / s_pooled
# s_pooled = sqrt(((n1-1)*s1^2 + (n2-1)*s2^2) / (n1+n2-2))
n1, n2 = len(obs_seeds), len(vla_seeds)
s_pooled = np.sqrt(((n1-1)*obs_std**2 + (n2-1)*vla_std**2) / (n1+n2-2))
cohens_d_seeds = (obs_mean - vla_mean) / s_pooled
print(f'\n=== Cohen d (per-seed means) ===')
print(f'  obs_only mean: {obs_mean:.4f} (n={n1})')
print(f'  vla_only mean: {vla_mean:.4f} (n={n2})')
print(f'  pooled std: {s_pooled:.4f}')
print(f'  Cohen d: {cohens_d_seeds:.4f}')

# 3. Pooled Cohen's d (treating each rollout as observation)
p_obs = obs_total_success / obs_total_n
p_vla = vla_total_success / vla_total_n
# For binary data, std = sqrt(p*(1-p))
# Pooled std = sqrt(((n1-1)*p1*(1-p1) + (n2-1)*p2*(1-p2)) / (n1+n2-2))
s_pooled_binary = np.sqrt(((obs_total_n-1)*p_obs*(1-p_obs) + (vla_total_n-1)*p_vla*(1-p_vla)) / (obs_total_n+vla_total_n-2))
cohens_d_pooled = (p_obs - p_vla) / s_pooled_binary
print(f'\n=== Pooled Cohen d (rollout-level) ===')
print(f'  obs_only rate: {p_obs:.4f} (n={obs_total_n})')
print(f'  vla_only rate: {p_vla:.4f} (n={vla_total_n})')
print(f'  pooled std (binary): {s_pooled_binary:.4f}')
print(f'  Cohen d (pooled): {cohens_d_pooled:.4f}')

# Welch's t-test on per-seed means for reference
t_stat, p_welch = stats.ttest_ind(obs_means, vla_means, equal_var=False)
print(f'\n=== Welch t-test (per-seed means) ===')
print(f'  t-statistic: {t_stat:.4f}')
print(f'  p-value (two-sided): {p_welch:.6f}')
"
